{{Top|leg}}
A '''Diagnostics module''' was a tool used by [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]] engineers which kept incomplete droids and other unfinished projects secured and locked in place. The diagnostics module used [[Durasteel/Legends|Durasteel]] bands to keep the subject in an erect position during initialization.

Sometime before [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[Holowan Massacre]] was brought about by the failure of the diagnostics module to contain the new [[Assassin droid/Legends|Assassin droid]] model [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]].
